note_manual: 2026-11-24 — 11-page Elsevier article (Powder Technol. 286 (2015) 561–571), no SI. The tool cut 11 regions (Figs. 2–7, Tables 1–5) and missed Fig. 1 (its caption block is merged with the right-column text on p.3). None were kept as-is: Figs. 2–7 came out column/page-wide with blank margins and the five tables as whole pages (Tables 4 and 5 as the same p.10 page). All re-cut by hand (400 dpi for the ≈800 dpi 1-bit line rasters, 600 dpi for the small Fig. 6, 300 dpi for the ≈200 dpi colour ternary maps Figs. 5 · 7, 400 dpi for the 8 pt tables) and Fig. 1 hand-cut (manual_crop), plus the 15 numbered equations (400 dpi) and 20 evidence paragraphs (400 dpi, ≤ 20 rule; 9 of them stack consecutive pieces across columns/pages). No page_* images. 47 crops in total, all opened with Read. Read-outs of Figs. 3, 4, 6 (55 markers) with the card's model re-computation are in digitized.csv; the pure-component markers reproduce the printed Table 1 ff_c within 0.00–0.04.
